set.body:
Scope: neurosurf4s core/IO; surface anatomy, realizations, reference surfaces and GIFTI/FreeSurfer fixtures.

Deliverable: Create an independent surface build over mesh4s/locus4s/spatial4s and the small shared anatomical declarations. Move surface-specific metadata, formats and intrinsic policies. Move volume projection separately in the optional spatial integration.

Acceptance:
- Basic surface ingestion/fields/geometry can compile and run with no neuroim4s volume/IO/transform/view modules, atlas, MVPA or ScalaFIM.
- No duplicate mesh/domain/frame authority remains; vertex order, medial-wall policy, reference identity and format-placement fixtures pass on JVM/JS where portable.
- Tests/assets move with the code; needed surface test support has no ScalaFIM testkit dependency.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: U5: Extract surface semantics and IO independently of volumes
